description: T-195: per-character voice for vocal cues. Keys are personality / asset ids (the scene character's `personality`); a scene character without an entry gets `default`. pitchCents shifts every sound of that character (resample, so formants move with it; keep it within about +-400 cents). spreadCents: each cue gets a deterministic extra shift in -spread..+spread from its hash, so repeats are not identical. levelDb trims the voice. pan (-1 left .. +1 right) overrides the seat pan (scene x position x seatPanScale, clamped) when given.
